aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng lists aws_iam_role.managed_ng in its depends_on, but it already references that role directly via `node_role_arn = ... aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn`, which creates the ordering implicitly. The explicit depends_on on the role is redundant (the depends_on on aws_iam_instance_profile.managed_ng and aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.managed_ng are not redundant and can stay).

null_resource.update_trust_policy lists aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution in depends_on, but its provisioner command already interpolates `${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}`, which establishes the dependency implicitly. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.update_trust_policy lists kubernetes_namespace.spark in depends_on, but its provisioner command already interpolates `${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}`, which establishes the dependency implicitly. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.
